For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.The bidder shall offer the price for the entire "Scope of the work" and other terms and conditions, which f orms integral part of this tender as per the General Terms and Conditions of GeM. 2. Payment terms shall be as per the Scope of Work. 3. The bidder shall enclose signed and sealed copy of the Scope of Work, as a token to acceptance to the tendered item's specification, along with the duly filled undertaking on official letterhead. 4. The bidder shall not quote/attach any price/price bid format along with their technical offer. The offer of s uch bidder will be summarily rejected. 5. The applicable EMD amount is Rs.5,000/- only (Rupees Five Thousand Only), However, bidders can submit "Bid Securing Declaration" in lieu of EMD, duly signed & sealed. 6. Salem Steel Plant has implemented Anti-Bribery Management System (ABMS) as per ISO 37001:2016 sta ndard and in order to involve the external agencies, the following undertaking is taken from the Suppliers / Contractors / Vendors “By participating in this tender, the Suppliers/Vendors/Customers are deemed to hav e undertaken that they shall not give or take any financial or non-financial bribe, to or from anyone during t he tender or during the execution of the contract, thereafter and if they notice any such incident happenin g, they shall report to SAIL Vigilance.” 7. The successful bidder is required to submits ecurity deposit of 3% (Three Percentage) of Total Order valu e in the form of Demand Draft/Bank Guarantee. The SDBG should be valid for the period till completion of d elivery period as per the purchase order with claim period of six months from the date of expiry. 8. Quotation submitted only by contractors who are registered in Salem Steel Plant Contract Registration C ell in the appropriate category 14 (a) & class D will be considered for tender evaluation. 9. The bidders are requested to refer the Buyer added bid specific ATC for all the tender terms and conditio ns. 10.The bid submitted by the sellers to whom LTE has been issued, shall only be considered for evaluation, b ids from any other seller shall be treated as unsolicited in the instant procurement case. However, the firm( s) interested to be registered as a seller to sail, should fill up the vendor registration form, hosted on the SA IL tender website and complete the due process of registration with sail plant/units. . 3.
